scripts.predev:pc: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('neutralino.config.json')); c.url='http://localhost:5173'; c.modes.window.hidden=false; c.modes.window.enableInspector=true; fs.writeFileSync('neutralino.config.json', JSON.stringify(c, null, 2));"
scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && concurrently "npm run watch:frontend" "npm run start:neu"
scripts.prebuild:pc: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('neutralino.config.json')); c.url='/'; c.modes.window.hidden=true; c.modes.window.openInspectorOnStartup=false; c.modes.window.enableInspector=false; fs.writeFileSync('neutralino.config.json', JSON.stringify(c, null, 2));"
scripts.build:pc: npm run prebuild:pc && npm run build:frontend && neu build --release
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:frontend && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run build:frontend && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:update: npm run build:frontend && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run build:frontend && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android-run.js
